fix(ci): repair psdk dynamic workflows

Summary:
- add GitHub credentials to the dart dynamic check bootstrap
- switch js release to OIDC-ready npm trusted publishing settings
- update release-java to setup-maven-action v1.19.0

Rationale:
- latest main branch CI fails before dart lint because melos cannot clone
  the ble_plugin GitHub dependency without credentials
- DAM-34 rework requires npm trusted publishing instead of the expired
  token-based release flow, which also needs id-token permission and a
  supported Node runtime
- release-java still uses an action revision blocked by the deprecated
  actions/cache dependency

Tests:
- git diff --check
- ruby YAML parse for .github/dyn-workflows/check.yml and release.yml
- local js install/build failed outside CI because canvas needs pixman-1
  on this workstation and the local Node 25 runtime is not the target
  GitHub runner environment
